rationale.consistency: License headers, module registration, nolint:bodyclose, interface guards, adapt test all match Caddy idioms; handler uses time.Duration JSON fields where siblings use caddy.Duration.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles NoBody, negative-disables, Upgrade/CONNECT skip, hijack clearing, rate overflow cap, short writes; but nested per-route wrapper is overridden by the server-default wrapper (inner arm wins), and final flush after Done is unbounded.
rationale.scope: Only requested surface plus a conventional adapt test; no refactors or dead code.
rationale.readability: Clear names, well-placed comments explaining deadline math and design choices; deadlineAfter is compact and documented.
rationale.robustness: Deadline errors disable further attempts and are logged; but per-route timeouts silently become ineffective under default server idle timeouts, and Flush bypasses intermediate wrappers via Ctrl.
rationale.maintainability: Shared IdleDeadline type reused by server and handler; minor duplication of arm/setDeadline between reader and writer; layering interaction between nested wrappers is an undocumented coupling.
